scientific_limitations: Equilibria and local stability of a deterministic node-independent SIS closure only.
No exact stochastic finite-population persistence, global basin, or epidemic extinction-time claim.
Identical unit recovery rates, complete transversal m-partite incidence and pure all-others-infected transmission; no pairwise effects.
The strict balancing result fixes total population and per-hyperedge infection coefficient.
title: A sharp endemic fold and a balancing principle for pure higher-order contagion on multipartite hypergraphs
